ops.title: Bound cleanup rejoin lookup to the requested worktree
ops.description: Owner: /root/ccx_targeted_stack_io. Source-confirmed: cleanup daemon Engine.revive iterates e.ordered() across every journal job before a targeted Remove/Defer/Adopt can match its selected path; status/scheduler indexes already exist but no path index serves rejoin admission. Current journal has roughly6,600 jobs. This establishes algorithmic whole-queue work, NOT a measured host CPU/IO cause. Next after active cleanup repairs: create CI-only paired32/4096 predicate/candidate-count fixture, then reuse seqKey/order machinery for a request-path index if actual cost warrants; preserve earliest-sequence match, symlink spellings, Expected/Force checks, immutable captures and fresh filesystem/activity rechecks. No TTL, cross-request eligibility cache or schema migration. Primary publication/installation tasks must not wait for this lower-priority work.

ops.text: Paired CI fixture proves actual predicate/candidate cost across32/4096 unrelated jobs before changing data structures, without host-pressure attribution.
If warranted, source/security-reviewed per-path sequence index preserves exact order, symlink, Expected, Force and live-identity semantics with bounded request work.
CI, normal merge/release/install and affected lookup counters verified before completion.
